קג.ja: גירה פי חיאתה ובעד ממאתה, ואגפל אמר אכ'רתה ג'מלה.
קג.en: — another in his lifetime and after his death, while he himself has been wholly heedless of the matter of his next world.

pairs.en: another in his lifetime
and after his death
while he himself has been wholly heedless
the matter of his next world
wholly

קג.ja: ומא אשבההמא פי ד'לך באכ'וין ורת'א ען אביהמא ארצ'א תחתאג' אלי כ'דמה ופלאחה, פאקתסמאהא בנצפין, ולא שי להמא גירהא.
קג.en: These two resemble, in that respect, two brothers who inherited from their father a piece of land that required tending and cultivation, so they divided it into two halves, and they had nothing else besides it.

pairs.en: These two resemble, in that respect
two brothers
who inherited from their father
a piece of land
that required tending and cultivation
so they divided it into two halves
and they had nothing else besides it

קג.ja: פכאן אחדהמא עאקלא חאזמא, ואלאכ'ר עלי צ'ד ד'לך.
קג.en: One of them was sensible and prudent, and the other was the opposite of that.

pairs.en: One of them was
sensible and prudent
and the other
was the opposite of that

קג.ja: פאלעאקל ראי אן שגלה בארצ'ה פקט יקטעה ען אלתחייל פי מעאשה ואסתג'לאב רזקה, פאסתאג'ר פי עמל ארץ' גירה ליעיש מן אג'רהֵ עמלה יומא ביום,
קג.en: The sensible one saw that occupying himself with his land alone would cut him off from contriving for his livelihood and procuring his sustenance, so he hired himself out to work another's land, in order to live from the wage of his labor day by day.

pairs.en: The sensible one saw
that occupying himself with his land alone
would cut him off from contriving for his livelihood
and procuring his sustenance
so he hired himself out to work another's land
in order to live from the wage of his labor
day by day

קג.ja: פכאן אד'א אנטלק מן עמלה לגירה פי עשי יומה אגתנם פסחהֵ סאעה מנה ועמל פי ארצ'ה בג'ד ונשאט, פאד'א אסתפצ'ל מן אג'רהֵ איאם קות יום או אכת'ר מן ד'לך תרך אלעמל לגירה פי תלך אלמדה ועמל פי ארצ'ה בגאיהֵ ג'הדה ונשאטה, פלא יזאל כד'לך חתי יכמל עמל ארצ'ה עלי אכמל מא ינבגי,
קג.en: So whenever he came home from working for another at the close of his day, he would seize the leisure of an hour of it and work his own land with diligence and energy; and whenever there remained over from his wages the provision of a day or more than that, he would leave off working for another during that interval and work his own land with the utmost of his effort and energy; and he continued thus until the working of his land was completed in the most perfect manner that ought to be.

pairs.ja: פכאן אד'א אנטלק מן עמלה לגירה
pairs.en: So whenever he came home from working for another
at the close of his day
he would seize the leisure of an hour of it
and work his own land with diligence and energy
and whenever there remained over from his wages

pairs.ja: איאם קות יום או אכת'ר מן ד'לך
pairs.en: the provision of a day or more than that

pairs.ja: תרך אלעמל לגירה פי תלך אלמדה
pairs.en: he would leave off working for another during that interval

pairs.ja: ועמל פי ארצ'ה בגאיהֵ ג'הדה ונשאטה
pairs.en: and work his own land with the utmost of his effort and energy
and he continued thus
until the working of his land was completed
in the most perfect manner that ought to be

קג.ja: פאד'א בלג וקת את'מארהא ואואן גלתהא חצלה וג'מעה ועאש מנה טול עאמה אלת'אני, פיעמל פי ארצ'ה עלי חכמה, ולא יזאל יסתזיד פי ת'מארה חתי תקום גלתה בקותה, ויפצ'ל לה מא יזיד בה ארצ'א עלי ארצ'ה.
קג.en: And when the time of its fruiting and the season of its yield arrived, he gathered it in and amassed it and lived from it the whole of his second year, working his land with wisdom; and he kept increasing its fruit until its yield sufficed for his sustenance, with a surplus remaining to him whereby he could add land to his land.

pairs.en: And when the time of its fruiting
and the season of its yield arrived
he gathered it in and amassed it
and lived from it the whole of his second year
working his land with wisdom
and he kept increasing its fruit
until its yield sufficed for his sustenance

pairs.ja: ויפצ'ל לה מא יזיד בה ארצ'א עלי ארצ'ה
pairs.en: with a surplus remaining to him whereby he could add land to his land

קג.ja: ואלאך' אלג'אהל למא עלם אן עמלה לארצ'ה יקטעה ען אכתסאב מא יתקות בה תרכהא ג'מלה וגפל ענהא, ת'ם אסתאג'ר אלי אלנאס פי עמל אלארץ', פאכ'ד' אג'רתה ועאש מנהא ותקוות בהא ולם יופק מנהא שיא גיר קותה ובלגתה,
קג.en: But the ignorant brother, when he knew that working his land would cut him off from earning that by which he might be sustained, abandoned it altogether and was heedless of it; then he hired himself out to people in working the land, and took his wage and lived from it and sustained himself by it, gaining from it nothing beyond his sustenance and his bare provision.

pairs.en: But the ignorant brother
when he knew that working his land

pairs.ja: יקטעה ען אכתסאב מא יתקות בה
pairs.en: would cut him off from earning that by which he might be sustained
abandoned it altogether
and was heedless of it

pairs.ja: ת'ם אסתאג'ר אלי אלנאס פי עמל אלארץ'
pairs.en: then he hired himself out to people in working the land
and took his wage
and lived from it and sustained himself by it

pairs.ja: ולם יופק מנהא שיא גיר קותה ובלגתה
pairs.en: gaining from it nothing beyond his sustenance and his bare provision

קג.ja: פכאן אד'א פצ'ל לה קות יומה ג'עלה יום ראחה ודעה ונזאהה ולם יפכר פי אמר ארצ'ה, וכאן יסתעמל אלאסתחמאם פי אלאוקאת אלתי כאנת תפצ'ל לה פי איאם עמלה,
קג.en: So whenever the provision of his day was left over to him, he made it a day of rest and ease and recreation, and gave no thought to the matter of his land; and he would take to bathing in those hours that used to be left over to him during the days of his labor.

pairs.ja: פכאן אד'א פצ'ל לה קות יומה
pairs.en: So whenever the provision of his day was left over to him
he made it a day of rest and ease and recreation
and gave no thought to the matter of his land
and he would take to bathing

pairs.ja: פי אלאוקאת אלתי כאנת תפצ'ל לה
pairs.en: in those hours that used to be left over to him
during the days of his labor

קג.ja: פבקית ארצ'ה עטלה לם תנבת שיא, בל עלאהא אלשוך ואנהדמת סיאג'אתהא וחמלת אלסיול ת'מארהא כקול אלחכים על שדה איש עצל עברתי ועל כרם
קג.en: So his land remained idle, bringing forth nothing; rather thorns overran it, and its hedges fell into ruin, and the torrents carried off its fruits — as the wise man said: "By the field of a slothful man I passed, and by the vineyard..."

pairs.en: So his land remained idle
bringing forth nothing
rather thorns overran it
and its hedges fell into ruin
and the torrents carried off its fruits
as the wise man said

pairs.ja: על שדה איש עצל עברתי ועל כרם
pairs.en: By the field of a slothful man I passed, and by the vineyard
